The defeated custom cockatrice is visibly prone with its jade torso, folded wing panels, legs, claws, crest, and curled tail forming a coherent death pose as combat UI clears. Residual feather effects limit fine floor inspection.

The native gold-loot panel is open while the fallen custom cockatrice remains visible in the blurred background. This supports the sampled corpse handoff only; the overlay prevents fine geometry inspection and the fixture does not establish ordinary lethal behavior or later corpse lifetime.
